title: Plays And Learning
modules: Principles Of Learning And Instruction: The Montessori
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the term given to learning about the relationship between two or more concepts."
Rule learning is the term given to learning about the relationship between two or more concepts.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used for teaching numbers, fractions, and the processes of squaring and cubing."
The Golden Beads are used for teaching numbers, fractions, and the processes of squaring and cubing.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of developing understanding of commonalties across events, objects, people or concept."
Inquiry is the process of developing understanding of commonalties across events, objects, people or concept.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an organized and coordinated set of materials and equipments, the use of which will promote significant learning in the child."
The prepared environment is an organized and coordinated set of materials and equipments, the use of which will promote significant learning in the child.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a popular item which children gleefully pull, tear and thrash around."
Old newspapers are a popular item which children gleefully pull, tear and thrash around.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a surrogate parent to the children for the period of time that they spend at the centre."
The staff member is a surrogate parent to the children for the period of time that they spend at the centre.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a popular piece of equipment in most schools."
The rocking boat is a popular piece of equipment in most schools.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used either correctly or incorrectly."
The auto-educative materials are used either correctly or incorrectly.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the mechanism by which the early childhood educator brings the child and different aspects of knowledge together."
The environment is the mechanism by which the early childhood educator brings the child and different aspects of knowledge together.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to the knowledge or observation of facts gained by means of the eye senses."
Visual experiences refer to the knowledge or observation of facts gained by means of the eye senses.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a source of information about the environment of the child. 3."
Play is a source of information about the environment of the child. 3.

TMA
The TMA is the continuous assessment component of your course.

Utilization
Utilization is the functional level of learning, at which children can apply or make use of their understanding of events, objects, people or concepts.

Heterogeneous grouping
Heterogeneous grouping is a sound pre-condition for social development.
______ refers to the child's ability not to respond to a stimulus which is different from the one for which the response was originally learned.
Discrimination
Discrimination refers to the child's ability not to respond to a stimulus which is different from the one for which the response was originally learned.
______ refers to the phenomenon where the same response is learned for an entire class of situations or events.
Concept learning
Concept learning refers to the phenomenon where the same response is learned for an entire class of situations or events.
______ is a gradual process where successive approximations to the desired behaviour are rewarded until the final behaviour appears.
Shaping
Shaping is a gradual process where successive approximations to the desired behaviour are rewarded until the final behaviour appears.
______ is a very vital aspect of development as the child experiences increasingly complex levels of functioning and behaviour at each successive stage of maturation.
Learning
Learning is a very vital aspect of development as the child experiences increasingly complex levels of functioning and behaviour at each successive stage of maturation.

process of extinction
The process of extinction is used to observe how well a particular response has been learned and it also shows that the learned behaviour can be unlearned.

Phenotypic factors
Phenotypic factors refer to those factors that lie outside the child.
